ideas.idea: Read the site origin from one shared data file instead of hardcoding it in the canonical
ideas.why: It is a concrete fix for the hardcoded staging canonical that stops the host drifting again.

ideas.idea: Expand the Dentist JSON-LD with address, openingHours, url, image, sameAs and geo
ideas.why: The existing block has only name and telephone, so the extra fields would add real local-business facts.

ideas.idea: Use international phone format +44 113 496 0000 in the schema
ideas.why: The schema currently has the national format 0113 496 0000, and schema.org prefers international format.

ideas.idea: Make the layout omit the meta description when it is empty, or fall back to a default
ideas.why: The layout in base.njk renders an empty content attribute for any page without a description.

ideas.idea: Add named dentists, GDC numbers, qualifications and Person schema to the team page
ideas.why: The team page names nobody and only says 'decades of experience', so this adds real entity information.

ideas.idea: Give each treatment detail (duration, suitability, price range) and show prices, since the services page claims 'simple and clear' prices but lists none
ideas.why: The services page is a bare four-item list and the pricing claim is unsupported.

ideas.idea: Substantiate or remove 'Trusted by thousands of local patients'
ideas.why: The homepage makes an unverifiable claim that could be backed with reviews or figures.

ideas.idea: Add an FAQ section with FAQPage markup
ideas.why: A mandatory FAQ is folklore, and FAQPage rich results are largely restricted by Google.

ideas.idea: Move the Dentist/LocalBusiness JSON-LD into base.njk so it appears on every page
ideas.why: Repeating organisation schema on every page is common boilerplate with little added effect, and the block is only broken on the contact page.

ideas.idea: Add MedicalProcedure/Service and BreadcrumbList schema
ideas.why: This is standard schema advice that suits almost any site, and a four-page site has no breadcrumb hierarchy.

ideas.idea: Add passthrough copy for src/img so reception.jpg is published, and add width/height to the img
ideas.why: The image isn't passed through by .eleventy.js, so it won't be published, and dimensions prevent layout shift.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter meta tags
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site and has little effect on search or AI discovery.

ideas.idea: Add a robots meta with max-snippet:-1 and max-image-preview:large
ideas.why: These are default-like directives that most sites could add, with little effect.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the insurance terms and put the terms on the services page
ideas.why: This reverses the deliberate, scoped data-nosnippet choice.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap from Eleventy collections with lastmod and automatic noindex exclusion
ideas.why: The static sitemap already drifted from the noindex state of Services, and generating it would prevent that.

ideas.idea: Add explicit AI crawler User-agent blocks to robots.txt
ideas.why: The existing 'User-agent: *' with 'Allow: /' already allows these crawlers, so the blocks add nothing.

ideas.idea: Add a /llms.txt
ideas.why: The brief states that having no llms.txt is not a problem, and the report itself says adoption is uneven.

ideas.idea: Make titles and descriptions more specific, such as 'Contact Brightside Dental – Dentist in Park Row, Leeds'
ideas.why: The Contact and Thanks titles say little on their own, and a more specific title helps people and search engines.

ideas.idea: Check that descriptions are under about 160 characters
ideas.why: All current descriptions are already short, so this has no effect here.

ideas.idea: Add a footer with NAP and opening hours, plus a header element, to the layout
ideas.why: The layout has only a nav and main, so a footer would give consistent contact facts on every page.
